ctx.x: Chris Smith wrote "Ballin' the Jack." But there was a dance called "Ballin' the Jack." And then, on and on, and I can think of a series of songs, you know what I mean, and these songs had a dance to go along with it. So I think that the dancing and the music are so interrelated that you have...when you think of one you have to think of the other. Sometimes, maybe, the dancers...I think like in the case of the Charleston,
I think that the dance was out before the song. But it's amazing, though, how related they were to each other.
